title: Integrated reporting: evaluation of a corporate sustainability report
description: In association with Paramark, Black Crystal completed Phase 1 of a company's journey to integrated reporting: an evaluation of the company's 2016 sustainability report, with advice on how best to present the available information in its 2017 edition. Gaps were identified, along with the essential KPIs to be addressed going forward, using the Integrated Reporting Framework, the Global Reporting Initiative, the ISO range of standards and local and international industry-specific standards. The Phase 1 gaps and recommendations were presented, together with how to proceed into Phase 2; at the time of the profile the report was in its second phase, implementing the Phase 1 recommendations.

title: Technical advisors to a REDD+ forest carbon project in northern Zimbabwe
description: In 2010 Black Crystal was appointed as technical advisors to a certifiable carbon reduction project in Zimbabwe, aimed at conserving forested areas and associated wildlife habitats in four Communal Lands in northern Zimbabwe. Carbon Green Africa supports a series of projects intended to uplift livelihoods and support the self-empowerment of local communities, with carbon credits generated through the REDD+ project an important source of community revenue. Black Crystal was largely responsible for the vegetation biomass and soil carbon fieldwork; the development of field protocols for data collection; and the checking, computerisation and preliminary analysis of vegetation and soil data. The project received Climate Community Biodiversity Standard validation in February 2012 and Voluntary Carbon Standard validation in September 2012; the profile describes it as only the second such project in Africa and one of the largest in the world.
